$Comment: Old Jack's errands board: two small jobs that change every four hours, beside his daily board.
Rotation Every Hours 4 is a span cadence, counted from the clock rather than a calendar boundary,
so every player sees the same two errands for the same four hours and a restart changes nothing.
One slot posts an errand from the Hallows_Eve_Night band, for after dark, and one from the
Hallows_Eve_Day band, for daylight; only the Hallows_Eve_Errand_ contracts name this board, and
each band has three of them. An errand is half a board job: half the work, half the flat pay,
with the board's own pay table on top. Grades names each band with the daily board's words.
Old Jack's conversation opens it from his menu, the line under his daily board's. Season makes
the board absent while the event is off; an errand left uncollected when the event ends shows
Collect in the player's Objective Book instead. Order 91 sorts it straight after the daily
board. Where keeps it in the Forgotten Temple: anywhere else it is left out of every list and
